newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Sept monetary base data due Monday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Sept monetary base data due Monday.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank expects to reveal monetary base data for September at 3 p.m. (1 p.m. EDT/1700 GMT) on Monday, a spokeswoman said.
The bank will also announce public sector debt levels for August.
In August, the monetary base contracted 4.8 percent while in July, total net public sector debt stood at 249.158 billion reais, or 34.7 percent of gross domestic product.
The bank had been expected to release the September figures on Thursday or Friday. No reason was given for the delay.
